name: live-translate-assistant
description: Local real-time meeting translation and bilingual response assistant
author: Memedem1n

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:win: npm run asset:icon && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:dir: npm run asset:icon && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.stt:prewarm: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/prewarm_stt_models.py --models small.en medium.en large-v3 --device auto
scripts.benchmark:sweep: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/model_sweep.py --manifest artifacts/bench_clips/manifest.json --runs 3 --warmup-runs 1 --stt-device auto --target-stt-ms 800 --target-first-token-ms 900 --target-assist-final-ms 2500
scripts.corpus:sync: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/sync_web_corpus.py --config configs/web_corpus_sources.yaml --output artifacts/corpus/web_corpus.jsonl --json
scripts.glossary:build: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/build_glossary_lexicon.py --input artifacts/corpus/web_corpus.jsonl --output artifacts/corpus/glossary.jsonl --json
scripts.finetune:dataset: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/build_finetune_dataset.py --input-dir artifacts/session_exports --output artifacts/finetune/interview_train.jsonl
scripts.finetune:prepare-lora: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/train_lora_interview.py --dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.jsonl --out-dir artifacts/finetune/lora_interview --profile-sequence 14b_ultra_lowmem_a,14b_ultra_lowmem_b,14b_offload_c --fallback-profile 7b_fallback --auto-fallback
scripts.finetune:prepare-lora:smoke: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/train_lora_interview.py --dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.jsonl --out-dir artifacts/finetune/lora_interview --profile-sequence 14b_ultra_lowmem_a,14b_ultra_lowmem_b,14b_offload_c --fallback-profile 7b_fallback --auto-fallback --run-smoke
scripts.finetune:package-ollama: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/package_lora_for_ollama.py --base qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_K_M --adapter-dir artifacts/finetune/lora_interview --model-name live-translate-interview-lora
